name: Central Suriname Nature Reserve
description: Central Suriname Nature Reserve protects 1.6 million hectares of untouched rainforest in the west-central part of the country. Mountains and lowland forest shelter over 5,000 recorded plant species, along with jaguars, giant armadillos, giant river otters and tapirs. Birdwatchers can look for harpy eagles, scarlet macaws and the flame-orange Guiana cock-of-the-rock among some 400 species.
